main_body: A wooden rack base (rows 26-46) holding three upright spears. It is drawn as a flat front view with horizontal bands and dark frame lines.
top_band: none. The column at x=8 goes from the spear shaft straight into the dark outline at row 26 and then into the front face. At x=11 the rows 26-27 are only a 1px dark line and a 1px light line (L=157), which is an edge line, not a top surface.
evidence: The rack body is drawn like an architectural elevation. A 1px light line at row 27 is the only thing marking a top, and the compartments below are flat horizontal bands with dark separators, with no top surface seen from above. The spears stand straight up from the dark outline. There is no top band for the base or the beams, so the base reads as a front elevation and fails the frame contract.

style.evidence: The candidate has 13 distinct colours and a median of 7 per tile, against 17-20 and 38-40 colours for the references, so it is much lower in density. Its outline is a tinted dark brown (0% neutral), which matches the Beodeul approach. The wood has about 4 steps with some grain bands, and the steel spearheads have 3-4 steps, which is shallower than the 5-6 of the references. Surfaces are largely banded fills without per-plank texture or dots, so it looks thinner than the reference props.
